strings.about.title: About AI Mon
strings.about.body:
AI Mon {version}
C++ / Win32 · Windows 10/11 x64

Shows today's usage from local logs on this PC.
Usage on other PCs and web services is not included.
Prompt and response content is neither stored nor transmitted.
